text: Once acid has built up, the curd becomes plastic in hot water. It can then be kneaded and stretched into a fibrous, elastic paste.

steps.note: The curd, in grains the size of hazelnuts, is left until the whey has 0.7–0.8 % lactic acid.
The curd is kneaded and stretched in the hot water.
The cheese is dry-salted, or the stretching water is salted instead.
